'''Dewbright''' was a stilt-[[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]].

==History==
Founded by [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[colonist]]s, who continued to dominate the population well after its earliest days, the city Dewbright was located in the southern hemisphere, opposite of the [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]] site. A stilt-city built high above the surface of the planet on elevated platforms, the city's foundations were laid down in a large cove on the eastern coast of the [[Crystal Sea/Legends|Crystal Sea]]. Using Dewbright as a center for clean-up efforts on the planet in response to the devastation wrought by the many wars that plagued the planet over its history. Using [[boat]]s to trust the sea and its tributaries to reach restoration sites across the planet, the Ithorians and other citizens worked to clean-up the debris left by the [[New Sith Wars]].
